args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18.
2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy.
3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback (on-call paged).
5. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
